Scan.// OrphanReclassifyMinutes: Safety-net sweep cadence + age gate. A Failed/unclassified failure older than this is reclassified+suggested (recovers rows a crashed scan stranded past its watermark). Also the max sweep frequency. Min 1.

FolderBrowser.// Roots: Folders the scan-source 'Browse…' picker may list (and never escape). Empty = every ready fixed/network drive on the API host. UNC roots allowed, e.g. \\fileserver\logs.

Oracle.// Connections: A Database scan source can use an Oracle connection: add it to ConnectionStrings and declare its engine with a companion key, e.g. "Billing": "Data Source=BILLPRD;User Id=maia_ro;Password=…" plus "Billing_ProviderName": "Oracle". No companion key = SQL Server. Oracle sources are scan-only (SqlScript / StoredProcedure fixes stay on SQL Server).
Oracle.// TnsAdmin: Folder containing tnsnames.ora, so a TNS alias in Data Source resolves. Empty = TNS_ADMIN env var, then %ORACLE_HOME%\network\admin. Not needed for EZConnect (Data Source=host:1521/SERVICE).
